scope: Read all finite-image evaluator bodies, generated constants and three image test bodies; reread the exact reducer and selected integration/accessor bodies. Earlier reviews cover other unchanged callers. Not whole-source coverage or production formal verification.

findings.finding: Only affine_nonzero can skip exact reduction, and only for an available nonzero image. A zero image, unavailable denominator inverse, unsupported order or exhausted image work returns to the prior exact proof with a fresh full coefficient budget. The image never certifies zero.

The selected prime exceeds the field order; a root of exact order L annihilates Phi_L modulo that prime. Constants are independently checked by direct integer-polynomial evaluation and native tests, in addition to compile-time primality/exact-order checks. These finite checks do not prove the evaluator bodies.

Fraction evaluation first maps signed numerator and positive denominator with Euclidean remainder, then requires a nonzero denominator image. Every inverse node similarly needs a nonzero image. Multiplicative inversion uses exponent p-2. Unavailable inverse images retain the exact fallback, including rational values whose denominator or numerator is a multiple of p.

Sine uses (zeta^-k-zeta^k)*zeta^(L/4)/2; cosine uses (zeta^k+zeta^-k)/2. Root 2 and root 3 use conjugate powers with denominators 8 and 12; root 6 multiplies them. These match the exact reducer embeddings and preserve their positive real branch selection through the shared plan.

Finite child reads require an earlier expression index. At most 512 values and 256 powers are held in fixed arrays. The nine differences use a-d,b-d,c-d. The three cyclic cross-product terms match the six signed products in exact reduction.

Modular add/subtract/multiply charge a separate counter and use checked u64 arithmetic. Valid residues and primes below 2^17 bound products. Fraction and angle exponent intermediates retain checked i128 arithmetic. Work counters do not count every loop, integer division or GCD step; separate fixed array, width, visit and depth bounds remain necessary. No exact latency, stack-byte or heap-byte bound is proved.

The added image reads immutable plan data and fixed constants, never approximation caches. It changes neither representations nor facts. Coordinate Real payload access borrows an existing nonrational Computable; it does not build a new graph. Existing cached dyadic eligibility still requires the immutable rational class.

All 64 orders exercise each finite expression variant with selected rational scales. Collision and bad-unit tests cover false-zero prevention and fallback. This is finite recipe coverage, not an exhaustive pair matrix, directed fuzz campaign, branch coverage measurement or formal proof.
